name: pagespeed
title: PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals
about:
Tracks Core Web Vitals for your key pages: field data (LCP, INP and CLS at the 75th percentile) from the Chrome UX Report and the Lighthouse performance score from PageSpeed Insights, for mobile and desktop, once a day. The plugin page shows Good, Needs improvement or Poor badges using the web.dev thresholds, 90-day trend lines and a whole-site summary, with Measure now on every row.
Add a Google API key with the PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report APIs enabled in the plugin's Settings tab, list up to 25 pages (or leave the list empty to track the home page and the 24 most recently published pages), then grant settings, web requests, database, entities and log under Plugins, then Permissions.
Limits: at most 25 pages. Pages with little traffic show Not enough field data. Lab scores are best-effort: a lab run that takes longer than the time a plugin call may use is retried up to three times a day, and the last good score stays on screen. Daily results are kept for 13 months.
features: Chrome UX Report field data: LCP, INP and CLS at p75
Lighthouse performance score, mobile and desktop
Good, Needs improvement and Poor badges with the web.dev thresholds
90-day trend line per metric, drawn on the plugin page
Whole-site field summary for your origin
Measure now for any tracked page
Up to 25 pages, or the home page plus the latest published pages
